attributes.title: 2027 Crossroads Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites Hotel & Conference Center Noblesville
attributes.summary:
Crossroads 2027, the Indiana VMA's annual conference, takes place January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Embassy Suites hotel and conference center in Noblesville, north of Indianapolis. The association lists 21 CE hours and describes the meeting as its main event for veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and students.

RVTs, assistants and practice staff pay $265 with state VMA membership or $365 without it for a complete pass; professional (DVM) passes are $470 for members and $760 for non-members. These prices rise after January 7, 2027, and one-day options exist. The discounted room block ($172 per night) closes December 28, 2026.

The page does not state whether the hours are RACE-approved or how many of them fall in a technician track; that detail is not published yet.
